Upstream earnings fell by $1.8 billion in the U.S. (lower liquids realizations, higher operating expenses and higher DD&A) and by $4.0 billion internationally (higher DD&A, lower realizations and an unfavorable currency effect).

spans.quote: The company’s proved reserves at year-end 2025 were approximately 10.6 billion barrels of oil-equivalent (BOE), eight percent higher than 2024.
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Chevron Corporation1,2 | $ | 12,299 | $ | 17,661 | $ | 21,369

Production The company’s worldwide net oil-equivalent production in 2025 was 3.7 million barrels per day, 12 percent higher than in 2024 primarily due to the acquisition of Hess and growth in TCO, the Permian Basin and the Gulf of America, which were partly offset by the impacts of asset sales.

U.S. upstream earnings decreased by $1.8 billion, primarily due to lower liquids realizations of $2.4 billion, higher operating expenses of $2.0 billion, and higher depreciation, depletion and amortization of $1.4 billion, partly offset by higher sales volumes of $2.8 billion, and higher natural gas realizations of $800 million.

International upstream earnings decreased by $4.0 billion, primarily due to higher DD&A of $2.8 billion, lower realizations of $2.0 billion, an unfavorable foreign currency effect of $803 million between periods, and the absence of prior year favorable asset sales impacts of $260 million, partly offset by higher liftings of $2.2 billion, and lower operating expenses of $470 million.

question: Summarize how each of Apple's product categories did in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
answer: iPhone, Mac, Wearables/Home/Accessories and Services all grew (Pro iPhones, laptops, Accessories and Wearables, advertising and cloud); iPad declined on lower iPad mini and iPad Air sales.

spans.quote: iPhone net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 primarily due to higher net sales of Pro models.
Mac net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 due to higher net sales of laptops.
iPad net sales decreased during the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025 primarily due to lower net sales of iPad mini® and iPad Air®.
Wearables, Home and Accessories net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 due to higher net sales of Accessories and Wearables.
Services net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising and cloud services.
